controles.affirmation: En organique, l'activite Aftermarket de Process Automation and Technology recule de 10 % en raison d'une baisse des livraisons de catalyseurs
controles.verbatim_source: Tableau 'Factors Contributing to Year-Over-Year Change', Process Automation and Technology, T2 2026 : Organic percent change | Net Sales (1)% | Segment Profit (10)%. Le commentaire dit seulement : 'partially offset by lower organic sales of $77 million in Aftermarket driven by a decline in catalyst shipments'. Ventes Aftermarket publiees : 926 M$ au T2 2026 contre 946 M$ au T2 2025, soit -2,1 % (10-Q/A T2 2026, Note Revenue Recognition).
